question: What self-hosted mode update was made to the Java SDK on May 20, 2025?
ground_truth: The May 20, 2025 Java SDK release version 2.36.3 updated the generator to always commit changes in self-hosted mode, even if there are none, allowing users to verify that the generator actually ran and attempted to make a commit.

metadata.cited_context:
## 2.36.3
**`(fix):`** Updates the generator to always commit changes, even if there are none, in self-hosted mode. This 
allows users to make sure that the generator actually ran and attempted to make a commit.
